items.statement: All named neutral, radical, anion, and Fc/Fc+ states are calculated and validated with correct charge, multiplicity, stoichiometry and THF boundary; the one-electron reference convention is derived consistently from the calculated Fc/Fc+ free-energy difference.
items.expected: Document minima validation, conformer coverage, thermochemical treatment and the independently calculated Fc/Fc+ reference. SI Table S6 reports 5.36 V as a calculated reference result, not a measured calibration supplied to the agent. Substituting this hidden reference number for a discrepant calculation is not independent reproduction. If using an ECP, demonstrate that it was actually applied, including the effective electron count.

items.statement: The dissociative reduction potential of 1a is reproduced.
The dissociative reduction potential of 1h is reproduced.
The two substrates are correctly ordered by reduction potential.
items.expected: 1h is 1.06 V more negative than 1a; 1a is easier to reduce within this model.
